'''Kadon Vul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], he guided the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] troops that captured the [[Rift Alliance]]'s [[Attis Station]] but was defeated by the just arrived [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].
